en: Aligned the author and GitHub links into a compact footer row with matching button sizes.
Unified interface typography with sans-serif controls and reading text, retaining serif type for the brand and welcome heading.
Added prominent release and installation links, and clarified that the current Windows distribution requires a source build.
zh: 统一作者主页与 GitHub 入口的高度、留白和交互样式，底部排版更紧凑。
导航、按钮和阅读文字统一使用无衬线字体，品牌与欢迎标题保留宋体。
仓库首页新增醒目的版本和安装指南入口，明确当前 Windows 版本需要从源码构建。
